title: REDCap data-dictionary template (importable)
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Hee-Lee Oss never holds patient data. An importable REDCap data-dictionary template generated from the CDE source of truth lowers the barrier for a partner pilot (depends on cde-020, terminology-021). Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Generate an importable REDCap data-dictionary template from the CDE dictionary, validated to import cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: Field types/value sets match the CDE dictionary (generated from the single source of truth)
